items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Did Marlo Morris play with you? He was a pianist... But if you had to swing, he could do that too.

ctx.x: Yes, well she was adopted. Raymond and his wife adopted her. Then he divorced his wife and married Dorothy. Warlow, Harry Warlow, that was his real name. Mark Warlow's brother.
Back to Hollywood and the Streets of Paris you mention in your story about Big Sid doing the driving, Marlowe Morris was in the car. Did Marlo Morris play with you?

He was a pianist. A very good pianist. He played more on the stride type of piano playing. Using his left hand, you know. But if you had to swing, he could do that too. He could play some beautiful ballads.
